name: GemBoards – Project Management, Task Management, Goal Tracking, Kanban Board, and, Team Collaboration
author: Kodezen LLC

sections.description:
Project Management tools

Generated / Compiled Assets

This plugin includes pre-built JavaScript assets located in:

  • assets/build/admin.*.js
  • assets/build/app.*.js

These files are compiled build outputs generated from the plugin’s source JavaScript using standard build tools (e.g. webpack / Vite).

Purpose:
– admin..js is used for the WordPress admin interface(settings page)
– app..js is used for the frontend SPA.

Notes:
– These assets are bundled locally with the plugin
– They are not loaded from external servers
– No tracking, analytics, or remote code execution is included
– No user data is transmitted outside the WordPress site

Source files:
– The original source code is included in the plugin repository
and can be found in the dev_gemboards/ directory
